title: Model of Models: When Does Emitting a Specialist Beat Attending, Adapting, or Tuning?
abstract: arXiv:2608.21386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a task described by a few examples, how should a model be specialized to it? Four mechanisms are available -- zero-shot, in-context attention, test-time gradient adaptation, and emitting specialist weights from a hypernetwork -- yet the operating regime of the last is rarely mapped. We run the identical four-way comparison across six tasks spanning regression, generation, language modeling, reinforcement learning, and clinical and genomic classification, holding the specialist, the context, and (where we can) the training budget fixed. The clearest wins for emission are about cost at matched quality: it ties the state-of-the-art amortized tabular model (TabPFN) on clinical few-shot classification while emitting a reusable specialist instead of re-attending the support set per query, and reaches noise-floor shape generation with a $132$-float per-instance program. On few-shot sinusoid regression it is $2$--$3$ orders of magnitude

translated_title: 模型的模型：何时发射专家优于注意力、适应或调优？
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.21386v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：给定一个由几个示例描述的任务，模型应如何专门化？有四种机制可用——零样本、上下文注意力、测试时梯度适应，以及从超网络发射专家权重——但最后一种的运行机制很少被映射。我们在跨越回归、生成、语言建模、强化学习以及临床和基因组分类的六个任务上运行相同的四向比较，保持专家、上下文和（在可能的情况下）训练预算固定。发射最明显的胜利在于匹配质量下的成本：它在临床少样本分类上与最先进的摊销表格模型（TabPFN）持平，同时发射一个可重用的专家，而不是每次查询重新关注支持集，并以每个实例132浮点数的程序达到噪声底形状生成。在少样本正弦回归中，它比基线快2到3个数量级。
tldr: 本文系统比较了四种模型专门化机制，发现发射专家权重在匹配质量下具有显著的成本优势，并在多个任务中达到或超越现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares four model specialization mechanisms, finding that emitting specialist weights offers significant cost advantages at matched quality, achieving or surpassing state-of-the-art across multiple tasks.
